native_mechanisms: Each byte is folded into an impure (pre-seeded) accumulator whose updated state becomes the seed for the next byte, so the whole buffer passes through one unbroken chained pour.
The final accumulator state is pushed through seven distinct finalizing bends, each shifting away half the word and keeping only the high-entropy remainder.
Flip one input bit anywhere and re-run the whole pour; any resemblance between old and new output condemns the method (avalanche acceptance test).
core_technique: Chained CRC-32C accumulation (SSE4.2 _mm_crc32_u64 / ARM __crc32cd, with a reflected 0x82F63B78 table fallback) over 8/32-byte blocks, cross-fed with a parallel rotate-add 64-bit accumulator and length-seeded init, closed by a MurmurHash3-style xor-shift/multiply fmix finalizer.
